273 section 13V the following section:-  
274  Section 13W. (a) There shall be established and set up on the books of the 
275 commonwealth a separate, non-budgeted special revenue fund known as the Sports and 
276 Entertainment Events Fund, which shall be administered by the office of travel and tourism 
277 established in section 13F. The fund shall be credited with: (i) revenue from appropriations and 
278 other money authorized by the general court and specifically designated to be credited to the 
279 fund; (ii) funds from public and private sources, including, but not limited to, gifts, grants and 
280 donations; and (iii) interest earned on money in the fund. The unexpended balance in the fund at 
16 of 146 
 
281 the end of a fiscal year shall not revert to the General Fund and shall remain available for 
282 expenditure in subsequent fiscal years.  
283  (b)(1) Amounts credited to the fund shall be expended, without further appropriation, for 
284 a competitive matching grant program administered by the office of travel and tourism for major 
285 sports or entertainment events to provide: (i) event services; (ii) sports development; (iii) sports 
286 marketing; or (iv) construction, functioning or operation of a sports or entertainment event; 
287 provided, however, that in evaluating grant applications, priority shall be given to applicants 
288 based upon expected return-on-investment and that clearly identify direct and indirect economic 
289 impacts on the tourism industry in the commonwealth and help promote the commonwealth in 
290 national and international media; and provided further, that no grant award shall provide more 
291 than half of the balance of the fund to any 1 recipient in any calendar year; and provided further, 
292 that the office of travel and tourism shall require a match of not less than one-to-one for any 
293 grants issued from the fund.  
294  (2) Grants under this section shall be awarded in a manner that promotes geographic 
295 equity.  
296  (c)(1) Any grant awarded pursuant to clause (i) or (iv) of paragraph (1) of subsection (b) 
297 shall require an applicant to provide complete and accurate responses and disclosures for itself 
298 and for any contractors or vendors to be utilized for the sports or entertainment event which shall 
299 include:  
300  (i) certification that the applicant and any contractors or vendors it utilizes have complied 
301 with chapters 149, 151, 151A, 151B and 152 and 29 U.S.C. 201, et seq. and federal anti-
302 discrimination laws for the last 3 calendar years;

304 and shall remain, in compliance with chapters 149, 151, 151A, 151B and 152 and 29 U.S.C. 201, 
305 et seq. and federal anti-discrimination laws for the duration of the services or labor;   
306  (iii) a disclosure by the applicant as to whether it and any contractors and vendors it 
307 utilizes to support sports or entertainment events have previously contracted with a labor 
308 organization, as defined by chapter 150A and section 2 of the National Labor Relations Act, in 
309 the commonwealth or elsewhere; and   
310  (iv) a disclosure by the applicant of its plans for assuring labor harmony for the duration 
311 of work to support sports or entertainment events both separately and in conjunction with its 
312 contractors and vendors.
